songs.title: What Will You Invent? 🚀
lines: Oh, what will you invent, my friend?
I will use metal, glass, and wires,
If I go deep under the sea,
If it gets dark, I'll need some lights,
n: 곡조: Pop Goes the Weasel (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
'Zoom!'에서 로켓처럼 두 손을 위로 쭉 뻗고, 'Splash!'에서 잠수하듯 손을 모아 아래로 내려가요.
songs.imgPrompt: Kid inventors in a workshop, one flying a shiny jetpack and another waving from a yellow submarine with bright lights.

songs.title: I Promise, I Predict, I Plan 🤞
songs.tune: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush
lines: I promise that I will study hard,
I will study hard, I will study hard,
I promise that I will study hard,
That is my promise to you!
I predict it will rain on Sunday,
It will rain all day, it will rain all day,
So I plan to play games in my room,
That is my plan for Sunday!
n: 곡조: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
'promise'에서 새끼손가락을 카메라에 내밀고, 'rain'에서 손가락으로 비 내리는 흉내, 'plan'에서 손바닥에 쓰는 흉내를 해요.
songs.imgPrompt: A girl making a pinky promise at her desk while rain falls outside and her brother plays board games in his room.
